name: endnote-research
description: Index and search exported EndNote libraries locally from Codex desktop.

interface.longDescription: Independent tool for indexing and searching local EndNote XML exports and PDF attachments. Search metadata and PDF evidence, format citations, and optionally use locally prepared semantic embeddings. Requires macOS, uv, and an exported library. Source files and the index stay local; retrieved evidence can enter the active AI conversation. This tool is not affiliated with EndNote or OpenAI.
